Attribute the aggregate to diseases (Shapley allocation)

Source: R/deconflate.R
attribute_burden.Rd

The expected aggregate impact is sum_i p_i b_i + sum_{j < k} delta[j, k] P(j and k). Removing any disease involved in a term removes that term, so each disease's Shapley value is its own term plus an equal share of every interaction term it is involved in. The shares add up to the aggregate. This is the contributions table of deconflate().

Usage

attribute_burden(result)

Arguments

result

A deconflate() result.

Value

A data frame with, per disease, the main contribution, the share of interaction terms, the total and the share of the aggregate (NA when the aggregate is zero).
